modeling_method: Original generic low-poly geometry and seeded procedural PBR pixels; no vendor meshes, BIM, proprietary assets, logos or photograph pixels copied. Reference photographs inspected locally but excluded from distributable.

references.observations: Primary manufacturer photo shows two rounded square flanges, forward support arms, telescoping spindle. Technical sheet gives 185 mm overall width, 135 mm mounting centres, 50 mm flanges; drawing distinguishes 85 mm and 100 mm depth measurements. Generic model uses 185 mm overall width and approximately 86 mm empty-hardware projection; roll and tail project farther. Original 108 mm wide/104 mm diameter paper roll is an artistic choice below vendor 140 mm capacity. Not a mechanically certified replica.

Primary manufacturer photograph shows softened square wall flange and broad bowed metal cap on forward support. Technical sheet dimensioned 105 mm width, 50 mm flange, 60 mm projection. Model uses this envelope but original raised-tip horizontal twin-hook profile, not exact product reconstruction.

materials.origin: Original deterministic make_textures.py seed 672685. Brushed steel, matte off-white paper, cardboard, dark gasket. No external textures.
materials.maps: 512px RGB PNG. Basecolor sRGB contains only albedo variation, no shadows/highlights. Tangent-space OpenGL +Y signed normal encoded into RGB [0,1], linear. Roughmetal linear R=255 G=roughness B=metallic; separate per-asset AO UV1, no lighting baked into basecolor.
materials.repeat: UV0 planar projection 0.25 m repeat; separate uniquely packed UV1 AO.
